items.text: AS YOU HIKE THROUGH THE MOUNTAINS YOU SEE A LARGE CAVE. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: OFF IN THE DISTANCE YOU SEE A LARGE DRAGON FLYING THROUGH THE AIR. AS YOU WATCH, HE SWOOPS DOWN BEHIND A MOUNTAIN AND DISAPPEARS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU HIKE THROUGH THE MOUNTAINS, A LARGE DRAGON FLYS ABOVE YOU. IT CIRCLES THEN SWOOPS DOWN AND LANDS IN FRONT OF A CAVE. IT DISAPPEARS INTO A CAVE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ENTER THE CAVE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU WALK THROUGH THIS AREA TWO ANHKHEGS ERUPT FROM THE GROUND BENEATH YOU.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A SMALL CARAVAN OF SLAVERS RIDE BY YOU TOWARD THE BUCCANEER BASE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HAVE REACHED THE BUCCANEER BASE. A BAND OF BUCCANEERS RIDE OUT TO ESCORT YOU IN. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A GROUP OF ARMED GUARDS RIDE BY.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A GROUP OF MEN ON HORSEBACK RIDE OUT TO MEET YOU. THEIR LEADER SAYS, 'ARE YOU THE DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS FROM NEW PHLAN?' WHAT WILL YOU SAY?
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: AFTER SAYING NO, THE RIDERS RETURN TO THE OUTPOST. BEFORE LEAVING, THEIR LEADER SAYS, 'YOU ARE TRESSPASSING ON PRIVATE LAND. I ADVISE YOU TO LEAVE.'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: THE RIDERS ESCORT YOU INTO THE OUTPOST.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU APPROACH THE KEEP, A GROUP OF ARMED MEN ON HORESBACK RIDE OUT TO MEET YOU. THEIR LEADER SAYS 'YOU ARE TRESSPASSING ON PRIVATE LAND; LEAVE NOW OR FACE THE CONSQUENCES!'
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: YOU HAVE FOUND A SMALL DARK CAVE. WILL YOU ENTER?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: OUT OF THE SHADOWS, TWO LARGE WILD BOARS CHARGE.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: NEAR YOU IS A LARGE, WILD BOAR SOW FEEDING HER YOUNG. AS YOU NEAR SHE GROWLS A WARNING TO STAY AWAY. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU APPROACH HER HAIR BRISTLES AND SHE ATTACKS!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AT THE END OF THE PASSAGEWAY ARE THREE LARGE WILD BOARS. THEY CHARGE AT YOU AND ATTACK!
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: LYING ON THE GROUND HERE ARE THE DISSOLVING REMAINS OF A DWARF. HE IS COVERED IN ACID.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE GROUND HERE IS SOFT AND FRESHLY CHURNED.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE REMAINS OF SEVERAL OF THE ANHKHEG'S VICTIM. ADMIST THE DEBRIS IS SOME TREASURE.
items.direction: expressive fantasy narration; perform quoted dialogue distinctly while remaining the same narrator

items.text: FROM THE SOUTH, A LARGE ANHKHEG LUNGES OUT AND ATTACKS THE PARTY.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: LYING ON THE FLOOR IS A LARGE, SHEDDED SNAKE SKIN.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A GIGANTIC SNAKE LIES IN FRONT OF YOU. IT REARS AND ATTACKS.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU WALK INTO THIS ROOM A GIANT SNAKE FALLS ON TOP OF THE PARTY.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THERE ARE TWO THRI-KREEN HERE. THEY BLOCK THE PASSAGE WITH THEIR BODIES. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE YOU ARE THREE THRI-KREEN WARRIORS. THEY ATTACK YOU IMMEDIATELY.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ENTER A CAVE ROOM WITH FOUR THRI-KREEN WARRIORS IN IT. ON THE FLOOR IS A CHEST WITH TREASURE IN IT. AS YOU ENTER THEY ATTACK.
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HAVE FOUND A PASSAGE WHICH LEADS OUTSIDE. WILL YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: measured, expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene
